use: Strict evidence-scoped NPC speech. A witnessed event is not an adjacent event at the same location. Distinguish negative witness from uncertain knowledge.

shiki.rain_genin.forest_encounter.limits: Ren personally witnessed the final Rain genin declare surrender while restrained; Aki did not personally witness the final kill. Do not give Aki the surrendered detail without report.

gaara.forest_death_actions.indirect_knowledge_possible: Arrival at the tower; hearsay; later testimony, if it actually occurs
gaara.forest_death_actions.limits: No member of Shiki's team watched Gaara fight or kill in the forest. Mere knowledge of 97-minute arrival or violent reputation does not make anyone an eyewitness.

gaara.hinata.prelim.limits: Ren personally watched Gaara injure Hinata and the official stoppage. He may draw inferences about Gaara's ability or brutality only from the arena bout.

gaara.shiki.cafeteria.limits: The question 'When you kill someone, do you feel you exist?' was Gaara speaking to Shiki; it is NOT a confession that Gaara himself only feels alive when killing. Infer with uncertainty.

mio.beam.rescue.limits: Neither Ren nor Aki saw the beam rescue; later reliable report must be explicit.

shiki.yoroi.medical_dialogue.limits: Kabuto saw Shiki go to the wing, not the content of his conversation with the surgeon; his guess remains conjecture.

shiki.kabuto.training_agreement.known_team_information: Aki knows that Shiki sought a private meeting with Kabuto; neither Aki nor Ren heard what they agreed on. Kabuto offered initial trial training at 06:30 Monday 8 July, but Shiki has not told either teammate as of 22:51 July 7.
shiki.kabuto.training_agreement.invalidated_line: Aki: «Завтра у Шики тренировка с Кабуто» said at ~22:49 July 7 in «Белая цапля» is NPC knowledge leakage and noncanonical. Ren's rejoinder about tomorrow's training is likewise noncanonical.
shiki.kabuto.training_agreement.retcon_scope: Do not invent Aki alternative dialogue. No game time advancement for OOC correction. Aki may ask or guess but not know time or training without an actual report.

shiki.kabuto.research_interests_july14.actual_dialogue: Генетическая ассимиляция, изменение биохимии, димеиленизация, блокада рецепторов, увеличение афиности рецепторов, изменение тока чакры, блок узлов распределения. Поэтому нейрофизиология и психофизиология тоже, но с ними я в большей степени дружу. Это то что вспомнилось сразу.
shiki.kabuto.research_interests_july14.kabuto_can_know: Shiki enumerated research interests, potentially including demyelination (term imprecise), receptor affinity and blockade, chakra node flow and distribution, biochemistry and assimilation. He did not answer whether research target is himself or others, does not disclose Zero Genome nor state an actual experimental procedure or chosen victim. Kabuto may infer, ask, misinterpret, or be skeptical, but cannot know unreported secret.
shiki.kabuto.research_interests_july14.limits: Do not make Aki/Ren hear scene. Do not claim Kabuto knows Zero Genome, genetic mutation or Shiki's intention of permanent modification. Distinguish research interest from achieved skill.

shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.other_presence: Librarian and some visitors elsewhere in the room, no evidence they directly observed the incision or regeneration. Do not imply universal knowledge.
shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.player_actions: Shiki gives ordered study levels (molecular, cellular, isolated systems, organism); explains current study is elective due to limitations in his village; for first time genuinely thanks Kabuto; takes ordinary scalpel and cuts own finger deeply, actively uses Zero Genome to heal, asks Kabuto to keep it private for now. No player authorization to disclose detailed inner workings or gift samples.
shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.kabuto_observations: He sees an intentional finger incision and anomalously swift self-healing, with chakra activity; he can infer unusually advanced healing/self-regulation but does not know the hidden name Zero Genome, its heredity or whole mechanism. He perceives Shiki's genuine gratitude as an unusual shift in visible expression.
shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.kabuto_obligations: Request for discretion is not an oath/automated guarantee. Kabuto has espionage agenda and autonomous interests; no automatic disclosure until it is played as an event with cause and time.
shiki.kabuto.visible_self_healing_july14.knowledge_boundaries: Aki and Ren not present, unaware of demonstration. No accidental bystander witnessing without narrated perception. No automatic source of blood sample for Kabuto.

corrected_historical_line.speaker: ren
corrected_historical_line.quote: Я видел, что этот Гаара сделал с Хинатой. И видел, что произошло в лесу.
corrected_historical_line.rejected_meaning: Ren personally saw Gaara fight in the Forest of Death
corrected_historical_line.permitted_meaning: Ren saw Gaara vs Hinata and separately witnessed Shiki vs Rain genin; do not blend these into personal observation of Gaara in forest.
corrected_historical_line.retcon_scope: Historical assistant text remains in chat source, but the implication about Gaara's forest battle is noncanonical. No invented new speech for Ren; future scenes use corrected knowledge.

require_check: Who personally observed exactly this event?
Is this event different from an adjacent one in the same forest, exam, or medical wing?
What is the referent of this/it/him/there/in the forest?
Does a reference to the previous conversation subject falsely imply witnessing a different event?
If indirect, identify who reported, when and with which wording; no report by inference alone.
If no source, phrase as speculation without fake eyewitness authority, or omit.
provenance: User OOC correction 'видел, что произошло в лесу. Нет не видел. Просачивание знаний. Протокол проверки просачивания усилить и сохранись' (2026-11-12). Later explicit user correction 2026-11-12: Aki did not hear Kabuto training agreement, and her dialogue stating the training happened via illicit GM knowledge.
